acquisition method: Data was acquired in data-dependent mode and controlled by XCalibur software (version 2.9).
alkylation reagent: subsequently reduced and alkylated in 10 mM tris (2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and 55 mM iodoacetamide (IAA), respectively.
alkylation concentration: subsequently reduced and alkylated in 10 mM tris (2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and 55 mM iodoacetamide (IAA), respectively.
cleavage agent: Proteolytic cleavage to peptides was carried out by incubating the proteins with a Trypsin/Lys-C protease mix (Promega GmbH, Walldorf, Germany) overnight at 37 °C, at a molar protein/enzyme ratio of 50:1.
collision energy: fragmentation by higher-energy collisional dissociation (normalized collision energy: 34).
enrichment method: The 35 nm qEV original size exclusion chromatography (SEC) columns (Izon 35, Izon Science, Christchurch, New Zealand) were utilized according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
fragmentation method: fragmentation by higher-energy collisional dissociation (normalized collision energy: 34).
instrument: 1 µg of labeled peptides were injected into an Easy-nLC 1200 coupled to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (both Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: Eluting peptides were ionized by electrospray ionization at 3.2 kV.
labeling: Peptides were chemically labeled with 10-plex tandem mass tag kit (TMT, Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to manufacturer’s instructions
mass analyzer: For MS2 scans in orbitrap mass analyzer, AGC target and maximum injection time were set to 1 × 105 and 110 ms, respectively.
precursor tolerance: A mass tolerance of 20 ppm (first search and fragment ions) and 4.5 ppm (main search) was allowed.
fragment tolerance: A mass tolerance of 20 ppm (first search and fragment ions) and 4.5 ppm (main search) was allowed.
ptm: Carbamidomethylation (cysteine) fixed; oxidation (methionine) optional; acetylation (protein N-terminus) optional
Carbamidomethylation (cysteine) was set as fixed modification, whereas oxidation (methionine) and acetylation (protein N-terminus) were set as optional modifications.
reduction reagent: subsequently reduced and alkylated in 10 mM tris (2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and 55 mM iodoacetamide (IAA), respectively.
reduction concentration: subsequently reduced and alkylated in 10 mM tris (2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and 55 mM iodoacetamide (IAA), respectively.
